note:
Current New Jersey Legislature — 40 Senate + 80 Assembly across 40 districts, each district electing one senator and two assembly members (verified).

Roster, emails, district offices, photos and official links come from the Open States bulk export (data.openstates.org/people/current/nj.csv). Open States is used rather than the Legislature's printable roster PDF because PDF text extraction inserted stray spaces inside surnames and silently corrupted five names (McKeon, Wimberly, Flynn, Tully, Pintor Marin).

frcaVote is the member's vote on FINAL PASSAGE of S49, the Freedom of Reproductive Choice Act, 10 January 2022, from the Legislature's own API (Senate VoteKey 2118, Assembly VoteKey 1571), both reconciled against the published tallies before use.

null means the member was NOT SERVING for that vote. It is not an abstention and must never render as one.
